en.title: Top 3 Trending Hashtags in a Time Window
en.description:
Count how many times each hashtag appears in the tweets within a closed time window, and return the top three, sorted by count in descending order and then by tag in ascending lexicographic order.

This site's standard input/output format and supplementary bounds are as described in this problem.
en.input: The first line contains n currentTime timeWindow (n≤2×10^5, total text length ≤10^6, timestamps and the time window are non-negative and ≤10^9). Each of the next n lines contains a timestamp, a tab character, and a tweet; a tag starts with # followed by ASCII letters/digits/underscores.
en.output: Output one hashtag per line, keeping the leading #; output nothing if there are no tags.
en.explanation: Scan only the text inside the time window, recognize and count tags character by character, then sort by `(-count, tag)`. The total scan is O(total text length), and sorting is O(H log H).
